lines.trans: Attention everyone in Production Unit One: this is our new chief producer, Mr Xie.
Before clocking out today, everyone must submit a resume and work brief to the chief editor office.
Hold on, where did this Mr Xie come from? Where is Mr Chun Yuqiao?
Unit One was built single-handedly by Mr Chun Yuqiao; how can it operate without him in charge?
How did it turn into Mr Xie? Where on earth has our Mr Chun Yuqiao gone?
No, wait—we got it all backwards!
We ended up proving that Xingtian can manage without Mr Chun Yuqiao after all.
Are you especially surprised to see me show up here?
Let me offer the three of you a piece of advice.
Rather than standing here in a daze, you might as well hurry and pack your belongings.
Because my own team is about to move into the chief editor office in full force.
You can start thinking about your own next career move right now.
